name: Wanderer
description: Many ihatei are given vessels by their clans and then use them for exploration in the hopes of discovering new landholds. Wanderers are much like the Scouts of the Traveller Core Rulebook, exploring in a lonely, risky way which provides a wide range of skills but also a great chance of disaster.

belter.name: Belter
belter.description: You mine asteroids for valuable minerals and salvage.

nomad.name: Nomad
nomad.description: You wander from system to system.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: You explore unknown worlds and survey planets for colonisation.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: Your ship crashes on an uninhabited world. Gain any one of Survival 1, Mechanic 1, Animals 1 or Recon 1.
mishaps.3: You fail to find work or usable territory. Starvation reduces your END −1.
mishaps.4: You are attacked by outlaws or raiders from another race. Roll Pilot 8+ to avoid rolling on the Injury table.
mishaps.5: A rival ihatei sabotages your ship. Gain Mechanic 1 from the experience of fixing it and gain them as a Rival.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Your vessel runs into a border patrol. Roll Pilot or Gunner 8+ to escape; if you fail, suffer DM-2 to your next survival roll.
events.4: You have extensive dealings with barbarians. Gain Tolerance 1 and one of the following: Broker 1, Diplomat 1, Independence 1 or a Contact.
events.5: You have the opportunity to trade Aslan goods. Roll Independence 8+; if you succeed, gain an extra Benefit roll.
events.6: You gain a Contact in a distant spaceport.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You pick up some useful skills working on your ship. Gain one of Pilot (Spacecraft) 1, Gunner (Turret) 1, Engineer 1 or Mechanic 1.
events.9: You are forced to recruit a new crew. Roll Carouse or Streetwise 8+. If you succeed, gain an Ally as one of your new crew proves a true friend. If you fail, one of the new crew robs you — lose any Benefit rolls from this term and gain an Enemy.
events.10: You spent time on the fringes of Aslan space. Roll Survival 8+ or Pilot 8+; if you fail, roll on the Mishap table but you may stay in this career. If you succeed, gain a Contact and any one skill.
events.11: You find new worlds for your clan to conquer. Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: You find unclaimed territory. Gain TER 1D+1.
